testcase.name: Product catalogue › search without a match says so
Product catalogue › category filter shows the same products as the API
Product catalogue › sort "Name (A - Z)" orders the products by name
Product catalogue › sort "Name (Z - A)" orders the products by name
Product catalogue › sort "Price (Low - High)" orders the products by price
Product catalogue › sort "Price (High - Low)" orders the products by price
Checkout as a logged-in customer › customer can order two products
Checkout as a logged-in customer › cart line prices and total add up
Checkout as a guest › guest is asked to sign in at checkout
Checkout as a guest › a cart filled through the API shows up in the browser
Login › customer can log in and lands on the account page
Login › wrong password is rejected with a message
Login › empty form shows a message for each required field
Login › customer can sign out again
Catalogue with a mocked API › renders exactly the products the API sends
Catalogue with a mocked API › shows a message when the API returns no products
Catalogue with a mocked API › a failing product API leaves the rest of the page working
Requests the front end sends › sorting asks the API for sorted data
Requests the front end sends › search sends the search term to the search endpoint
Product details › card and detail page show the same name and price
Product details › adding a product with a quantity updates the cart badge
Product details › the + button raises the quantity by one
